verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover uploading custom model weights from Hugging Face, local files, S3 or Azure Blob ([fireworks-ai-docs-7], [fireworks-ai-docs-33]), including programmatic upload via the REST API ([fireworks-ai-docs-64]). LoRA adapters can be served by live merge or by multi-LoRA with dynamic adapter loading at request time ([fireworks-ai-docs-8], [fireworks-ai-docs-24], [fireworks-ai-docs-32]), and a single firectl command creates the deployment ([fireworks-ai-docs-23]). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the custom upload and serving workflow.
